# Passcreator

Passcreator is a SaaS platform that enables businesses to create, distribute, and manage digital Wallet passes for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet, including store cards, event tickets, coupons, and membership cards.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/passcreator/.

## Actions

- **Check Pass Existence** (read-only): Check if a pass exists for a given external id.
- **List Pass Templates** (read-only): List pass templates.
- **List/Search Passes** (read-only): List or search passes.
